card.name: Inside ring-compound chemical names
card.fires_on: Partway through names of ring-shaped chemical compounds, such as pyrimidinyl, imidazolidinyl, quinoxaline, quinazoline, benzene and indanedione, where the next piece will be -ine, -yl, or the word ring or derivative.

modes.label: Heterocycle names
modes.description: Middle pieces of nitrogen-ring names like pyrimidine, imidazole, quinazoline.

modes.label: Before ring or derivative
modes.description: A ring-compound stem that is followed by the word ring or derivatives.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like ring, rings, derivative and derivatives after a ring-compound name.
card.plain: It fires inside the names of ring-shaped chemicals, when a word like ring or derivative is likely to follow.
